# Seat 1 second audit addendum — intermittent source-proposal byte drift

2026-10-15, appended after independent download/diff of full GitHub Actions artifacts. This supersedes the earlier tentative assumption of a stable OS-specific numerical difference; original evidence remains unchanged.

- Initial **pre-W-correction** [CI 38718317046](https://github.com/JesseBrown1980/asolaria-stone-to-moss/actions/runs/38718317046): 72 matching semantic decisions, 72/72 differing `received_proposal_sha256` values between Linux and Windows, different HBP SHA256 (`d7068ca4...` and `08aa622c...`). Old first-run scenario W in A/B was incorrectly modeled; see the preceding additive correction.
- First **post-W-correction** [CI 38719131366](https://github.com/JesseBrown1980/asolaria-stone-to-moss/actions/runs/38719131366): 72/72 semantic decisions matching; **72/72** proposal SHA fields different across OS. Semantic digest **`e07558181ed548986398e6638187317fd1562698ce56210f78b8ebe8041b1c96`**. Both runner jobs and the semantic-only audit passed.
- Second **post-W-correction** [CI 38719137293](https://github.com/JesseBrown1980/asolaria-stone-to-moss/actions/runs/38719137293): 72/72 semantic decisions matching, **0/72** proposal SHA differences, raw full traces **exactly identical** SHA256 `d93f617e628023eefcb88c09d8a1c3ac239b96f91faedeae0a4f375a01c3d2a3`. Both individual runner jobs passed but the aggregate **failed**, because its first version required 72 SHA disagreements. This is a *brittle auditor prediction*, not a failed recovery/authentication gate.
- The actual upstream Q-PRISM code imports NumPy/SciPy, seeded generators and transcendental numerical operations. Input challenge digests were identical on every run. The cause of transient byte differences is **not yet established**; do not claim it is necessarily OS-specific, floating-point, random generation, package version or hardware behavior without an experiment isolating it.

The revised independent cross-platform verifier accepts either exact raw matching or the explicitly flagged 72-digest raw divergence, **never a different semantic decision**. It pins the corrected W-case semantic SHA above and preserves each CI run's raw trace digest and sidecar. This distinguishes structural reproducibility from precise floating-point/proposal-byte reproducibility. Future tasks: pin NumPy/SciPy versions, compare same-OS cold replays, print numerical source fields to distinguish schedule/BEHCS/score rounding and move any canonicalized receipt format behind an independent precision/error-budget review.

**Promotion boundary:** 72 mathematical/software outcomes under the stated synthetic fault injection, not 72 independent physical subjects; genuine Ed25519 source origin and human consent remain outside the public test-key fixture.
